content: man7 lsblk(8) util-linux 2.43: lsblk -nr -o MOUNTPOINT DEV prints one raw headerless line per device row (whole disk then partitions, dependency order); unmounted rows are empty strings; MOUNTPOINT shows only one mount point (MOUNTPOINTS for all); unsafe chars hex-escaped in raw mode; exit codes 0 success 1 failure 32 none of specified devices found 64 some found some not; man recommends udevadm settle before lsblk when udev db may lag. Source: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/lsblk.8.html
